ns2:section.sectionText: This section will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 15, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This will open to Technical Systems Management students on Monday, November 22, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. BUSINESS MINOR/PROSPECTIVE BUSINESS MINOR STUDENTS: This section will not open to you since all students are required to take the online option, if offered, as stated on the Business Minor website. BADM 300 is offered online in the fall, summer and winter terms. No exceptions will be made. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technical Systems Management or Food Science & Human Nutrition or Business Undeclared or Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship or Ag Production & Processing or Construction Management or Digital & Precision Ag or Energy and the Environment major(s) or minor(s).
